titleStmt.title: The Canterbury Tales: The General Prologue

respStmt.name: Peter Robinson and the Canterbury Tales Project

publicationStmt.p: Demonstration pressing of materials from talesofcanterbury.org, offered by the editor as a test case. The source files are included verbatim. Materials under copyright: this is a temporary demo, it will be removed.

sourceDesc.p: Transcripts of all witnesses and the full collation of the General Prologue, from the Canterbury Tales Project, https://talesofcanterbury.org/GP/. Witness names from the edition's own list of sigils.
